saints.name: St. Pacificus of San Severino
saints.title: Priest
saints.shortBlurb: A Franciscan preacher of the Marches who, struck blind, deaf, and lame, turned his long affliction into a hidden life of prayer…
biography: Born at San Severino in the March of Ancona in 1653 and orphaned young, Pacificus entered the Franciscan Reformati and was ordained in 1678, labouring for some years as a missionary preacher among the country people. He then lost his hearing and sight and became lame, so that he could preach no longer.

For nearly thirty years he bore these infirmities with serene patience, giving himself instead to prayer, especially before the Blessed Sacrament, and to counsel of those who sought him. He died at San Severino in 1721, was beatified in 1786, and canonized by Pope Gregory XVI in 1839.
saints.knownFor: His patient endurance of affliction and his hidden life of prayer.

sources.text: Catholic Encyclopedia (1913), "St. Pacificus of San Severino"
